overall_notes: This paper introduces the MiTTenS dataset for evaluating gender mistranslation in translation systems. It focuses on automated evaluation using accuracy and custom heuristics rather than human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods. The extraction was fairly accurate but included some items that were mentioned in passing rather than actually used in the study.
